experiences: Green Village Anuradhapura Home Stay Tours & Experiences About Reviews Travel Guide Gallery Menu ☰ Home Stay Tours & Experiences About Reviews Travel Guide Gallery Plan your visit Plan your visit Tours & experiences Walk through 2,500 years of living history. Visit the world's oldest documented planted tree, stand before towering ancient stupas, explore royal gardens and monastery ruins — all with Gunarathna by your side, sharing the history, Buddhism, culture and traditions that still shape this sacred city. Places you'll visit Every monument has a story. Gunarathna tells it. This is not a checklist tour. Each site is introduced with its history, Buddhist significance, cultural meaning and the traditions that locals still practice here today. 01 Sri Maha Bodhi The oldest documented planted tree in human history — a sacred fig tree grown from a branch of the very tree under which the Buddha attained enlightenment. A site of deep devotion. 02 Ruwanweli Maha Stupa A luminous white dome and one of the most revered Buddhist monuments in Sri Lanka. Especially beautiful in the soft light of early morning or late evening. 03 Ancient Alms Hall The remains of a great refectory where thousands of monks once gathered to eat. A powerful reminder of the scale of monastic life in the ancient city. 04 Jetavanaramaya & Museum Once the tallest brick structure in the ancient world. The on-site museum holds remarkable artefacts that bring the monastery's story to life. 05 Isurumuniya Temple A rock-carved temple famous for its exquisite stone carvings, including the celebrated “Isurumuniya Lovers.” An intimate, atmospheric space beside water. 06 Royal Pleasure Garden Tranquil parkland where ancient royalty once relaxed, surrounded by pools, pavilions and carefully positioned shade trees. 07 Wessagiriya Monastery A quieter monastery complex with cave inscriptions and meditation platforms — a peaceful place away from the crowds that reveals monastic solitude. 08 Other Stupas & Sacred Sites Mirisawetiya, Abhayagiriya and more — Gunarathna selects the route based on your time, interests and the most meaningful way to experience the sacred city. More than monuments History, Buddhism, culture and tradition — explained by someone who lives it. Gunarathna doesn't just point at ruins. He explains why the Bodhi Tree is still worshipped today, what each stupa symbolises in Buddhist philosophy, how the ancient irrigation systems shaped Sri Lankan civilisation, and the traditional customs and rituals you can still see in villages around Anuradhapura. From the meaning of temple offerings to the architecture of monastic life, from royal history to the everyday traditions that have survived for centuries — this is a conversation, not a lecture. Signature experience Tour Anuradhapura with a local guide. A thoughtful introduction to the sacred city's landmarks, Buddhist traditions, cultural heritage and ancient stories — hosted in fluent English. about: Green Village Anuradhapura Home Stay Tours & Experiences About Reviews Travel Guide Gallery Menu ☰ Home Stay Tours & Experiences About Reviews Travel Guide Gallery Plan your visit Plan your visit Meet Gunarathna A teacher who became the island's most loved guide. From a countryside classroom to the sacred ruins of Anuradhapura — Gunarathna's journey has always been about sharing what he loves. His story Two decades of sharing this place with the world. Gunarathna is, first and foremost, an English teacher. For years he has taught children in the countryside — not in city schools, but in the communities that need it most. Many of these children come from underprivileged families, and Gunarathna supports them as a volunteer, giving his time, patience and encouragement freely. That same passion for teaching found another home in tourism. With more than twenty years in the industry, Gunarathna brings the ancient city to life for travellers from every corner of the world. His fluent English, calm storytelling and deep knowledge of Buddhist heritage turn a tour into something far more personal — a conversation, a friendship, a memory. Today he is one of the highest-reviewed tour guides on Airbnb, recognised by travellers not for rehearsed scripts, but for genuine warmth and understanding. A journey in milestones From the classroom to the sacred city. Every chapter of Gunarathna's life has been about connecting people to knowledge, culture and each other. 📚 English Teacher Years spent teaching English in countryside schools — helping young minds unlock opportunities through language. 🤝 Volunteer & Mentor Dedicated volunteer work supporting underprivileged children with learning materials, guidance and a belief in their potential. 🏛️ 20+ Years in Tourism Two decades of welcoming travellers to Anuradhapura, turning ancient ruins into living, breathing stories. ⭐ Highest Airbnb Reviews Recognised as one of the top-rated guides on Airbnb — not by marketing, but by hundreds of heartfelt guest reviews. What guides every welcome 01 Warmth Guests are treated with the same care he gives his students — patience, kindness and a genuine smile. 02 Understanding History and Buddhist culture are explained clearly, respectfully and at a pace that lets you truly absorb it. 03 Connection Meals, village routines and conversation create space for the kind of cultural exchange that stays with you. 04 Community Hosting supports Gunarathna's continuing volunteer work with local students and families in the countryside. A positive local story A teacher's heart, a traveller's trust. Long before hosting his first guest, Gunarathna was already giving back. As a volunteer English teacher in the countryside, he has helped children who might otherwise have no access to language education — providing stationery, uniforms and learning materials from his own resources. Today, part of the family's tourism income continues to support these students. When you stay at Green Village or join a tour, you become part of a story that reaches far beyond ancient monuments. guide: Green Village Anuradhapura Home Stay Tours & Experiences About Reviews Travel Guide Gallery Menu ☰ Home Stay Tours & Experiences About Reviews Travel Guide Gallery Plan your visit Plan your visit Anuradhapura travel guide A sacred city best understood slowly. Anuradhapura is not a single attraction. It is a wide living landscape of stupas, monasteries, reservoirs and active devotion. Places to understand Begin with the stories, not a checklist. 01 Sri Maha Bodhi A deeply revered living site connected to the tree under which the Buddha attained enlightenment. 02 Ruwanwelisaya A luminous white stupa and active place of worship, especially atmospheric in softer morning or evening light. 03 Jetavanaramaya A vast ancient brick stupa whose scale reveals the ambition of the old monastic city. 04 Isurumuniya A rock temple known for carved stone, water and a more intimate atmosphere. 05 Mirisawetiya An important stupa and the listed meeting area for Gunarathna's Airbnb experience. 06 Ancient tanks Historic reservoirs that soften the landscape and offer calm moments between monuments. Visit respectfully Small actions matter in a sacred place. Cover shoulders and legs at temples and stupas. Remove shoes and hats where required; hot ground makes socks useful. Do not pose with your back directly toward a Buddha image. Ask before photographing worshippers, ceremonies or monks. Carry water, sun protection and footwear that is easy to remove. Practical planning Make room for the whole experience. Allow enough time A guided half-day covers important sites, but a slower overnight visit creates space for village life and quieter moments. Choose your transport Explore by bicycle, tuk tuk, car or your own vehicle. The sacred city is extensive — Gunarathna adapts the route to whichever way suits you best. Check current tickets Prices can change with exchange rates. Use the official Central Cultural Fund page before your visit. Official ticket information ↗ Ask a local Opening conditions, ceremonies and the best order can vary. Gunarathna can shape the day around your interests.
